eps.ov: Klen and Alicia head to a school in search of Drel's secret room.
Alicia digs deeper into the mysteries of Solsein.

eps.t: The Hero Legend and the Village of Origin
eps.ov: The secrets of the hero legend are revealed.
Klen takes bold action to lure out Vordin.
Alicia fights her doppelganger in a strange world.
Vordin manipulates the students in an all-out battle against Klen.

eps.t: The World We See, And the Hidden World
eps.ov: Alicia learns about the second world hidden in the mirror, as the battle between Klen and Solsein continues.
Ray challenges Klen, and questions where he got his face.
Milea puts her plan into motion in the hidden world.
Alicia faces Milea in the hidden world.
Clevatess begins his battle with Vordin as Alicia is trapped in a cold illusion.

eps.t: The Millennium of a Dark Beast Lord
eps.ov: The true hero's story is revealed.
Clevatess's battle with Vordin concludes as a new foe appears.
